description: Use this when the user asks about one player's season or recent form ('Tatum stats', 'how is Bridges playing lately'). Returns season averages, efficiency (NBA: TS%, eFG%, USG%, BPM; NFL: yards, touchdowns, EPA), Keel Impact, current injury status, his recent box lines (five without an account, ten signed in) and, when the books have priced his next game, one compact row per stat as props_research gives it. With Keel Stats Pro, `detail` adds the book-by-book odds, closing lines, game log, history and alternate ladders. The answer's `account.held` names what the caller's plan left out. Not for on/off or teammate splits (player_splits_and_on_off).

detail.description: Keel Stats Pro: "compact" (default), "full" (the long answer), or a comma-separated list of sections: "books", "ladders", "closes", "games", "history" (as in props_research).

player_id.description: Numeric player ID from the search tool.

season.description: Optional season year (e.g. 2026 for 2025-26 NBA or 2025 NFL). Defaults to the current season.
